jobs.prompt: Bump the version from 1.167.3 to 1.167.4. In package.json and package-lock.json (both places in the lock: the top version and packages[""].version) change 1.167.3 to 1.167.4. In README.md change every 1.167.3 pin (kickoff text, tag name) to 1.167.4. In these tests replace the 1.167.3 pin with 1.167.4 where it is the current-version pin (assertions, test titles, the pin map in the AH release test): tests/t101-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lesson-t80-cli.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-x.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ab-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ag-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ah-release.test.mjs. In CHANGELOG.md add a NEW top entry ## 1.167.4 above the 1.167.3 entry (keep it unchanged) with the lead-in line: The project page no longer goes blank, and wide waves start. And these two bullets: Bullet one, bold lead word Board: the project page rendered nothing when one panel failed (the removed spend panel threw and the error was swallowed); it now renders every panel, shows an error banner when loading fails, and has a large-ledger test. Bullet two, bold lead word Wave prep: one ticket that cannot be prepared (uncovered tests, a test file the ticket creates, oversized or binary context) is parked with a warning instead of aborting the whole wave, and tickets move to running only after the manifest validates. Do not touch any other file.
